roll.before: dowels alone 164 N·m = 1.60× stall at a 240 MPa bearing allowable, equal sharing assumed
roll.after: 106 N·m = 1.03× the 102.9 N·m stall, 3.0× the 35.1 N·m drive limit (dowels bonded into the adapter; dry: 69 N·m = 0.67×)
roll.basis: bearing allowable 150 MPa (reverted from 240: cast A380-class σ_y ≈ 160 MPa with no bearing factor, ESTIMATE until the seller names the boss material; a steel or wrought 6061-T6 boss would justify ≈ 240). 3 × Ø4 × 4 mm on r 14.25: 2.40 kN each; dowel stiffness 41 kN/mm (Huth, Ø4 steel in 4 mm Al + 7 mm 7075); the first dowel takes k·δ before the others touch: δ 8 µm (H7/m6 spread, ISO 286) when the dowels are bonded (Loctite 638) into Ø4.1 adapter holes while seated in the motor (the adapter's hole positions drop out) → 93 N·m; dry in jig-bored holes δ ≈ 40 µm (± 0.02 true position each side, ESTIMATE) → 56 N·m (the review's ≈ 55 N·m); equal sharing 103 N·m. + 3 × M4 × 10 csk at 2.0 kN, μ 0.15, metal on metal (no creep): 13 N·m (strip of 2.65 mm effective M4 in the cast boss ≈ 3.9 kN). Dowel shear 242 N·m (ISO 8734). Criterion: stall is a fault, checked at a yield-level bearing allowable at ≥ 1.0× (as bolts ≤ proof); the 7075 adapter side is 7 mm deep. The 140 N bump puts up to 113 N·m on the roll output (1.07× this capacity): below the stall only if the actuator backdrives at its current limit (open: backdrive torque, seller / bench)

roll.item: M1 rear mount: 8 × M4 into the 3.5 mm housing threads
roll.before: 8 × M4 × 18 + washer + picked shim through 13.9 mm of PETG at 0.5 kN (4 µm of bolt stretch; friction 38 N·m at × 0.75 creep)
roll.after: metal clamp: M4 × 25 ISO 10642 10.9 (6) / ISO 4762 12.9 in the stop bushes (2) through a 3 mm 7075 rear plate and Ø6/4.4 steel sleeves onto the motor at 1.6 kN → 1.12 kN after embedding (no print in the stack); friction 56 N·m = 1.60× the drive limit; engagement 3.0 ± 0.49 (never bottoms in 3.5)
roll.basis: stack per screw: bolt 13 + sleeve 7 + plate 1 µm/kN, 5 metal interfaces × 2 µm embedding (VDI 2230, ESTIMATE) → 70 % left, no creep term (the printed floor + cup ring are sandwiched between the plate and the motor face, sleeves -0.05 mm vs the print: located, not clamped). Friction μ 0.15 steel/Al (ESTIMATE). Engagement 25 − 22 = 3.0 mm, worst ± 0.49 (screw length js15 ± 0.42, ISO 4759-1; plate ± 0.05, sleeve ± 0.02): 2.51–3.49 in 3.5 mm, so no shim picking; strip at the shortest (2.16 mm effective) 3.2 kN vs the worst bolt 1.82 kN (1.8×; motor bearing 2330 N × 40 mm → 94 N·m on the bolt circle, under the 310 N·m that opens it, load factor 0.39). Stall reaction through the sleeves into the print: 2.7 MPa bearing (Ø6 × 19 mm, 8 sleeves). Sleeve yield (D26 stock tube): rear 6 × 0.8 seamless E235+C precision tube 139 MPa at the worst bolt vs 235 (1.69×); clevis M5 8 × 1.2 seamless E235+C precision tube (press fit in the print: the bearing path) 100 MPa at 1.5 kN + the 137 N·m worst output moment on PCD 64 vs 235 (2.34×)

roll.item: M1 roll support: 61806 (rear) + the motor's output bearing
roll.before: 61806 on a printed stub, located axially, 68 mm from the motor bearing: hyperstatic (review: binds or idles)
roll.after: 61806 floats axially (± 0.3 mm on the stub) and is bonded into an oversize seat in situ; the misalignment preload is bounded by the printed support's radial stiffness: ≤ 800 N (worst) / 240 N (RSS). 61806 s0 2.2 service / 1.0 fault (need 1.5 / 1.0); the motor bearing needs ≥ 1417 N radial in service, 3130 N at a fault
roll.basis: reactions from the twin wrench of the roll output (the static roll stage taken off) on supports -32.5 / 36.5 mm (69 mm apart): service (basket, hug × 1.5) 61806 530 N, motor 617 N; fault (bump, stall) 1986 / 2330 N. Misalignment: the stub and the cup's driver pilot are one print (Ø75.2 pilot on the Ø75 driver, 0.1 radial) → static offset ≤ 0.25 worst / 0.15 RSS mm (pilot fit + print coaxiality 0.1 + motor 0.05, ESTIMATE); the rotating seat's own error (the clevis/arm print loop) is taken out by bonding the outer race (Loctite 660, 0.3 mm radial gap) with the arm bolted at mid-travel. Radial stiffness of the printed rear support 1.6–3.2 kN/mm (fea.md: stub 288 N → 0.13 mm, rear arm 525 N → 0.09 mm, in series; × 2 upper bound, ESTIMATE). The extra 61806 friction at 800 N is 18 mN·m (SKF μ 0.0015): it does not bind or blind the collision observer. **Deleting the 61806** (the review's option) needs the motor's output bearing to carry 119 N radial + 36.6 N·m tilting in service and 345 N + 137 N·m at a fault (about its own centre): only a crossed-roller or a preloaded pair with M0 ≥ 137 N·m qualifies. Seller question still open (output bearing type, C0, M0) — until then the 61806 stays

roll.basis: F = τ / r: 836 N at 35.1 N·m, 2450 N at stall, contact 4 mm off the plate. The bushes sit on the screw circle (r 42) at -68.75° / 156.25° (REAR_ANG0 21.25°, rear arm half-width 28.21: contact at -16.5° / 104°). Load path: bush → plate (Ø10 × 3 fitted, 3.44 kN, 115 MPa vs 7075-T6 σ_y 435) → the 6 csk screws (cone seats) → the motor housing: the stall torque closes housing ↔ output in metal; the print sees only the bush's Ø7 × 19 mm tail as a foundation (rigid bush on the plate pivot, linear pressure: 13.7 MPa at stall, 4.7 at the limit). Bush 42CrMo4+QT (R_p0.2 ≥ 750, EN 10083-3): 415 MPa in the Ø7/4.3 tail at the plate, 137 MPa in the Ø10/7.2 head. Edge distances: plate ring r 35–48: 1 mm outside the Ø10 hole, load along the ring (end distance ≥ 3 d to the next screw); print: 0.9 mm from the tail to the driver pilot (load tangential).
